package fixture

import (
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
)

// a compiled leg's helper: build the generated crate, then run its binary
func buildAndRun(t *testing.T, dir string) string {
	t.Helper()
	build := exec.Command("cargo", "build", "--release", "--offline")
	build.Dir = dir
	if out, err := build.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("cargo build: %v\n%s", err, out)
	}
	out, err := exec.Command(filepath.Join(dir, "target", "release", "probe")).Output()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("probe: %v", err)
	}
	return string(out)
}
